newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed and a shade weaker.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed and a shade weaker.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed and a shade weaker after the market drifted with virtually no buying interest, traders said.
"The market has hardly changed from morning -- that means no buying or inquiries," said a trader.
Another trader said an improvement in weather, noted in most parts of the region, was pressuring producers to reduce prices as the stock situation of raw materials was turning favourable as well.
The MRELB quoted January RSS1 buyer at 317 cents ($1.26) a kg, down half cent from Friday.
